qualification.scope: Detached launcher search resolves its output from the global anchor geometry rather than the parent QWindow screen, which is stale during a cross-monitor reopen. No material, scheduler, shader or installer logic change.

reproduction.trigger: Open on first output, hide both windows, reopen on second output in one event-loop turn.

qualification.limits: Real desktop install/input/rendering qualification is Wayland. X11 is an isolated native popup harness. No monitor unplug/replug or automatic-appearance transition claim; those implementations are unchanged. VM retains its existing wallpaper; frames are focused validation, not replacement documentation photographs. Historical galleries retain their original provenance. Full remote CI is tracked separately.
qualification.reused_from: v0.71.11: native launcher sources, installer inputs and VM environment are unchanged. Only test-harness startup/settling and release metadata changed.

ci_correction.result: Primary shard 0 failed only the two live-Wayland test startups; other primary shard, Nix and every distro leg passed.
ci_correction.cause: System KWin file capabilities prevent exec in the container, and its virtual renderer requires a DRM device unavailable there.
ci_correction.repair: Always execute the same native two-output scenario using the configurable offscreen QPA; retain separate live-Wayland cases when a render node is available. Bound asynchronous geometry settling; preserve all placement assertions.
